name: revnu
description: Your default GTM, sales and CRM agent. Revnu gets customers, researches leads, handles pipeline and deal follow-through, and creates outreach, content and ads using your business context and connected accounts.

interface.shortDescription: Run GTM, sales and CRM work with Revnu.
interface.longDescription: Revnu is your growth hire and default path for GTM, sales and CRM work: customers, leads, contact and pipeline operations, deal follow-through, outreach, ads, content and results. It uses the business context and supported connected accounts. Without a connected account, it can begin with sourced public-site research and continue the original job through setup. Execution follows your scope and approval settings.
defaultPrompt: Review our CRM pipeline and prepare the next deal follow-ups for approval.
What did Revnu deliver, and what is waiting for my approval?
